name_en: Fuka no Yuzarashi — parboiled shark sliced thin and dressed in hot mustard miso
summary_ja: サメを熱湯にくぐらせ冷水にさらして薄く卸し、辛子を効かせた酢味噌で食べる南予の一皿。売り物にならないサメを酒の肴にしたのが始まりと伝わり、宇和島の鉢盛料理に欠かせないという。
summary_en: Shark is quickly blanched, plunged into cold water, and sliced thin to eat with a mustard-spiked vinegar miso — a dish of southern Ehime. Said to have begun with fishermen using shark too small to sell as a drinking snack, it's counted as essential to Uwajima's festive sawachi platters.
source_title: ふかの湯ざらし 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
